meta.title: Suggestion code action adds another JSDoc
meta.fix_ref: microsoft/TypeScript#52276 (fix(52274): Suggestion code action adds another JSDoc), 6f338b9936, 2023-01-20; git tag --contains: first in v5.0-beta / v5.0.2
meta.build_notes: npm typescript@4.9.5 (2023-01-30) and typescript@5.0.2 (2023-03-16), both behind typescript-language-server@3.3.0 (the latest wrapper release before 5.0.2), started with the pinned tsserver.js; the reported TypeScript version is checked on every session. The report was made with 4.9.4; 4.9.5 is the last 4.9 release and does not contain the fix.
meta.notes: TS8024 is a suggestion diagnostic in .ts files (published by the wrapper with severity 4). The buggy fix inserts an empty '/** */' after 'export' and leaves the mismatched @param tag in place.

settings_note: The issue names no settings; no tsconfig.json, so tsserver uses an inferred project.

files.source: issue body, first code block (step 2: 'type the following code')
files.note: the file name is not given in the issue (the maintainer's trace uses x.ts)

repro.steps: Open index.ts: the suggestion diagnostic TS8024 appears under n ('JSDoc @param tag has name n, but there is no parameter with that name'). Request code actions there and select "Delete unused '@param' tag 'n'". Reported: the code becomes 'export /** */ const zero ...' with the wrong @param tag still in place; expected: the tag is deleted. Probe: after the fix, a fresh session on the edited file must neither report the targeted TS8024 nor a new error.
